articles.summary: Approval enables site-specific heat and power systems, expands IMSR Plant access to industrial markets, and supports early commercial operation using natural gas as a bridge to nuclear power Approval shortens critical path to plant commercial operation and revenue CHARLOTTE, N.C.
articles.title: Terrestrial Energy Submits Topical Report to NRC to Confirm IMSR Plant’s Thermal and Electric Facility Can Be Built and Operated Ahead of Nuclear Licensing
